Linux sidebar crash fixed, archives extract again, security updates.

- Linux: clicking a section in the sidebar could freeze Reach or crash
  WebKitGTK's web process. Fixed. Reported by @Wassermann1 (#143).
- Extract in the file explorer left the new folder empty. Fixed.
- New session and Quick Connect showed nothing while the sidebar was
  collapsed. Fixed.
- Security updates: rustls, tokio, webpki, the updater, zip (deflate
  only) and SvelteKit 3.

Full details: https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
